title: OnboardingTour
subtitle: The version-control rychlý kurz — two-layer infographic (live layer over Save -> Publish -> Pull) + coach-marks over the real controls · runs on the existing tour engine · no git jargon
brief: Phase 29 (native collab app, epic E4). The collab tour runs on the existing tour engine (overlay.jsx): a centered infographic step + coach-marks that spotlight the real Save / Publish / Get-latest controls + the presence layer. Teaching-model DDR: REVERSES collab-model-design.md Part 2's 'hide the duality' — we surface a visible three-verb cycle (Save changes locally / Publish for everyone / Pull changes) and teach the live-vs-async split honestly. The infographic is the hero (carries the whole mental model): a LIVE layer (cursors / who's here / comments — automatic, no buttons) floating ABOVE the work cycle, the two layers NEVER mixed. No raw git terms.

artboards.label: A · The infographic — the two-layer model (hero)
artboards.note: The centered tour step: a green-ringed LIVE layer (Together · automatic — cursors / who's here / comments) floating over the bridge ('the work itself') over the accent-tracked Save changes locally -> Publish for everyone -> Pull changes cycle. The signature moment — the whole mental model in one picture.

artboards.label: B · Coach-mark — Save changes locally
artboards.note: Coach card docked right over a dimmed mini studio-shell; the 'Save changes locally' button in the mini Changes panel carries the accent spotlight ring (how overlay.jsx renders at runtime).

artboards.label: C · Coach-mark — Publish for everyone
artboards.note: Same mini-shell, the 'Publish for everyone' control spotlit; card explains 'put it on the shared shelf'.

artboards.label: D · Coach-mark — the live layer is automatic
artboards.note: The presence avatars (YO/AN) in the mini menubar carry the spotlight; card: cursors / who's here / comments need no buttons — the top layer, always on.

artboards.label: F · The one honest hard thing — apart, you pick (never a merge)
artboards.note: Centered card: branch glyph + Keep mine / Keep theirs / Keep both pills (accent / info / success); copy teaches that publishing covers a live teammate, and only when apart do versions drift — then you pick, never a merge.
